name: koti-mcp
description: Scaffold Bun + (Express or Elysia) + MongoDB TypeScript API projects with RBAC, JWT auth, and Swagger docs through natural language.
long_description:
Koti MCP server lets AI assistants create and manage full-stack TypeScript API projects (Express or Elysia).

**9 Tools:**
- `create_project` — Scaffold a complete project (Express or Elysia) with auth, RBAC, Swagger, security middleware
- `create_model` — Define Mongoose models with optional CRUD endpoints and RBAC permissions
- `edit_model` — Add or remove fields on an existing model; regenerates CRUD files with .bak backups
- `create_controller` / `create_service` / `create_middleware` — Generate architectural components
- `create_enum` — Create TypeScript enums
- `create_task` — Add RBAC permission tasks
- `seed_database` — Populate MongoDB with default roles and admin users

**3 Resources:** Inspect project structure, existing models, and RBAC tasks

**2 Prompts:** Guided workflows for full API scaffolding and model creation

Instead of running 10+ interactive CLI commands, describe what you want and the AI does it all.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Scaffold a complete Bun + MongoDB API project with your choice of Express or Elysia framework (JWT auth, RBAC, audit, documents/S3, tinyURL, Swagger, email).

tools.name: create_model
tools.description: Creates a TypeScript Mongoose model with interface definition, optional CRUD endpoints (controller, service, routes, validation), and optional RBAC task generation.

tools.name: edit_model
tools.description: Add or remove fields on an existing model; regenerates CRUD files with .bak backups.

tools.name: create_controller
tools.description: Creates an empty controller (class for Express, handler object for Elysia).

tools.name: create_service
tools.description: Creates an empty TypeScript service class.

tools.name: create_middleware
tools.description: Creates a middleware function (Express) or plugin (Elysia).

tools.name: create_enum
tools.description: Creates a TypeScript enum with string or number values.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Adds a new task to the Task enum for role-based access control. Tasks are permissions that can be assigned to roles.

tools.name: seed_database
tools.description: Runs the seed script to populate MongoDB with default roles (Super Admin, Admin) and users (superadmin, admin). The database must be running.

prompts.name: scaffold-api
prompts.description: Guided workflow: create project, define models, set up RBAC, and seed database

prompts.name: add-crud-model
prompts.description: Guided model creation with full CRUD endpoints and RBAC permissions
